Title: Pick What to Fire
Description:
Current version is v0.0.1

Adds a toggle ability that, when toggled on, gives you a popup to select which missile weapon to fire when trying to fire your missile weapons (if you aren't firing all of them at once).

Base game behaviour picks a random weapon that excludes the last one you fired, which for most characters results in alternating (only two slots).

This mod allows you to decide which of your equipped missile weapons to fire, on a shot-by-shot basis.

Having Akimbo active bypasses the ability added by this mod. Toggle the ability off to revert to the base game behavior.

Cancelling out of the weapon selection cancels the "fire missile weapon" action, but can be modified to the base game behaviour (picking one at random) from the options menu.

The popup includes two hotkey-sensitive buttons, "[F] Default" and, if you've fired one already, "[R] Last Fired". These buttons are gamepad compatible and mappable in the control mapping menu. Their defaults are set to the default for "fire missile weapon" and the default for "reload missile weapons", respectively, to make spamming (almost) as easy as it is otherwise.

More testing required to know if it'll work with existing saves. Let me know if it doesn't and I'll add support for it.
